visible_observation: The feature story title 'The Cartography of Leaving' is rendered in a dark color that is nearly identical to the dark teal background of its container, making it almost illegible. Additionally, the footer text at the very bottom of the page is cut off, with only the top halves of the letters visible.
critique: The feature title fails a basic contrast and legibility check, undermining the 'polished' mandate. The footer clipping indicates a failure in the vertical height budget, violating the requirement to keep all elements physically inside the 800px boundary without relying on overflow concealment.
revision: 1. Change the color of the feature story title to a light color (e.g., off-white or light cream) to ensure high contrast against the dark teal background. 2. Reduce the vertical spacing (margin/padding) in the lower sections or slightly reduce the height of the feature card to pull the footer text fully up into the visible y=0..799 range.
protected_strength: The strong visual hierarchy that clearly distinguishes the dominant feature story from the four secondary articles and the sidebar, as well as the clean, grid-based alignment of the secondary article cards.
